publicTask.instructions: Implement Counter through the supplied public port: Initialize resets actual stored count to zero; Tick adds stride 2 or 3; observe reports actual count. There is no upper cap. Produce adapter.mjs and a build script under the approved build contract.

files.text: The adapter entry is adapter.mjs, an ESM module exporting createAdapter(). It returns {actions: {Initialize: () => void, Tick: ({Stride: bigint}) => void}, observe: () => ({Count: bigint})}. Initialize resets actual SUT state; Tick accepts Stride 2n or 3n; observe reads actual SUT state. Export no model protocol handlers. The approved build command runs /runtime/node/bin/node /source/build.mjs and must create the adapter and runtime files under /output. Author build.mjs and public tests; do not read a model oracle. Source and output are separate mounts.
